runtime.server_runtime: unknown; no server patch was inspected

common_envelope.unknown_id_rule: No client-provided scope field grants authorization; applicable IDs are compared with the separately supplied trusted scope.

older_1_0_to_current_1_1.facts: Downgrade every imported fact to unknown; retain prior value only as candidate_values and preserve provenance.
older_1_0_to_current_1_1.permissions: Discard old claims as authority; set section to unknown when legacy claims were present and to absent when missing.
older_1_0_to_current_1_1.source_identity: Preserve source identity and provenance. Missing retrieval time is represented as retrieved_at_status=unknown.
older_1_0_to_current_1_1.missing_optional_sections: Normalize to presence=absent with empty items.
older_1_0_to_current_1_1.unknown_additive_fields: Preserve non-sensitive fields in the normalized input as inert data; never infer facts, permissions, locks, or executable actions from them.
older_1_0_to_current_1_1.sensitive_fields: Recursively omit fields whose normalized names identify credentials, tokens, secrets, passwords, authorization, bearer values, API keys, or cookies; record only field_path and credential_material_omitted.

research_compatibility.unknown_optional_sections: Represent absent, unknown, and present independently; absent/unknown sections contain no items.
research_compatibility.unsupported_versions: Return a typed unsupported_version or unsupported_major ContractError.

creative_boundaries.readiness: Any conflicting/unknown fact or missing per-asset reproduction permission keeps the package incomplete.
creative_boundaries.brief: Verified facts, unresolved facts, source identity, preferences, interpretations, permissions, and locks are separate fields; when a research package is supplied, references, values and content hash are cross-checked.

design_control_translation.hash: control_schema_hash is canonical SHA-256 of the exact local creative-controls payload; outer validation can compare the supplied payload.
design_control_translation.trusted_versions: expected_versions binds brief, design, and composition identities for a consumer to compare.

edit_plan_actions.parameter_rules: Each action has a fixed parameter shape, 1 to 20 steps, at most 32 composition changes, at most 8 correction references, 8 KiB parameters, and bounded nested JSON values.

creative_boundaries.design_version: design_hash is SHA-256 over the canonical record with design_hash omitted; artifact content_hash is separately retained, and nested artifact_id is checked against trusted artifact scope.
creative_boundaries.edit_plan_base: Every EditPlan binds both base.brief_hash and base.design_hash; supplied current hashes are compared before accepting a plan.

decision_port.batching: Independent questions may be planned together only when none depends on another. The DAG planner returns ordered ID batches only; it neither executes requests nor creates updated dependent state.
decision_port.result_status: complete only when all answers are valid and no policy uncertainty trigger exists; abstention or low confidence/uncertain Noul requires review; timeout, cancellation or unavailable uses a typed safe fallback.
decision_port.usage: Completeness is complete, incomplete, or unknown; known provider input/output counts are retained even when the decision is malformed, unavailable, timed out, or cancelled; unknown usage has no fabricated counts.
decision_port.structured_observation: Observer identity, content hash, uncertainty status, bounded summary and optional source reference; no raw raster input.

hashing.serialization: UTF-8 JSON; object keys sorted by Unicode code-unit order at every depth; no insignificant whitespace; array order retained; finite JSON numbers only; -0 serialized as 0.
hashing.content_identity: Canonical hash changes when any included field changes, including preserved unknown additive fields; design_hash alone is omitted from its own DesignVersion input.
